components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action for opening the latest radar or visiting GitHub.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 45px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid #171716; border-radius: 0; background: #171716; color: #eeeae2; font: 700 12px Satoshi, sans-serif; transition: transform .2s ease, background .2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e86443; border-color: #e86443; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e86443; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(.98); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Text-first filtering for titles, topics, sources, and tags.
components.css: .ds-input-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid #d2cec4; background: #f7f5ef; color: #6d6a63; } .ds-input-search input { min-height: 34px; flex: 1; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #171716; font: 400 13px Satoshi, sans-serif; } .ds-input-search:focus-within { border-color: #e86443; outline: 2px solid rgba(232,100,67,.2); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Selection Rail
components.description: The persistent navigation language for topics and archive cuts.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); border-top: 1px solid #171716; border-bottom: 1px solid #d2cec4; } .ds-rail a { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 20px 12px; border-right: 1px solid #d2cec4; color: #6d6a63; font: 700 11px IBM Plex Mono, monospace; } .ds-rail a.is-active { box-shadow: inset 0 -2px #e86443; color: #171716; background: #f7f5ef; } .ds-rail a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e86443; outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-rail span { color: #929087; font-size: 9px; }

narrative.overview:
RadarKit treats information as film on a workbench: every Signal is a frame, the rail is the reading order, and the orange tape mark shows where attention stopped. The experience is a reader first — editorial enough to reward staying, technical enough to make provenance and state visible.

The visual world is built from graphite, paper, hairline dividers, and one signal-coral accent. It is deliberately not a SaaS cockpit: no widget mosaic, neon atmosphere, decorative gradients, or ornamental glass. Motion is limited to the sweep of a live radar, a restrained reveal for rows, and tactile transforms on interaction.
keyCharacteristics: One continuous rail for navigation and filtering.
Paper/graphite light and dark scenes with the same geometry.
Coral is a mark of activity, not a second palette.

rules.name: The One Tape Rule
rules.body: Coral is the only chromatic accent. Use it to show signal, selection, or action; never as ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Signal-First Rule
rules.body: Headlines carry the product voice; mono labels carry system state. Never make a small eyebrow do the work of a headline.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface earns elevation only when it owns focus or needs to read as a physical instrument.

dos: Do keep the first viewport split and left-aligned.
Do use source, topic, date, and score as real reading metadata.
Do preserve the coral mark as a scarce state signal.
Do keep motion transform/opacity-based and honor reduced motion.
Do make desktop and mobile use the same rail grammar.
donts: Don't turn the reader into a widget dashboard.
Don't add neon gradients, decorative glass, or a second accent color.
Don't use rounded cards as the default container language.
Don't hide source provenance behind a secondary interaction.
Don't treat synthetic Signals as production data; label them until the radar has generated real Markdown.
